text:
maria: Alerting 5m - several customers report users created via SCIM after SSO sign-in ended up with "read-only" role instead of their mapped admin/editor roles. Looks like provisioning retried and completed but the role attribute was empty.

maria: KMS shows repeated Decrypt errors around the same time: "InvalidCiphertext: Ciphertext header/padding error" when trying to unwrap the EncryptedAttribute from the SAML assertion.

maria: Quick dump of the POST body captured at the SP ingress (redacted):
```
SAMLResponse=PHNhbWxwOlJlc3BvbnNlIHhtbG5zPSJ...TRUNCATED...
&RelayState=...
```
(the base64-decoded EncryptedData appears shorter than what IdP logs show)

akshay: That "TRUNCATED" bit is suspicious. Two likely culprits: 1) a reverse-proxy/ingress chunk limit or buffer setting that clipped the end of the form body, 2) something URL-decoding and stripping trailing '=' padding on the SAMLResponse param. Either will corrupt base64 and KMS can't decrypt.

olivia: Check nginx/ingress: proxy_buffers, proxy_buffer_size, and uwsgi_buffer_settings if we're using uwsgi. We had an incident last year where large SAML + RelayState hit proxy_buffers and the tail got dropped.

olivia: Also check for middleware that normalizes/form-decodes fields. I remember a small Lua telemetry hook was added to decode fields for analytics. If it runs `ngx.unescape_uri` twice it can remove padding.

samir: Infra change log shows `ingress-controller` helm upgrade rolled out 30m before the alerts. New template included `proxy_buffer_size: 4k` and `proxy_busy_buffers_size: 8k`. Rolling that back now.

samir: infra-bot: rollback started for chart/ingress-controller -> v2.3.1 (previous values restored). CI green. :white_check_mark:  

akshay: While rollback runs, can someone capture the raw TCP stream to prove truncation vs decoding? Command: `tcpdump -i eth0 -s 0 -w /tmp/acs.pcap 'tcp port 443 and host <idp-ip>'` then `tshark -r acs.pcap -Y 'http.request' -T fields -e http.file_data` to extract the form body.

maria: I pulled IdP debug logs (Okta) and their SAMLResponse blob length is ~12.8KB. Our captured decoded cipher is ~8.1KB. That gap matches the ingress buffer sizes that were lowered.

amendment: also saw evidence of double urldecode in `lib/telemetry/decode_hook.rb` (legacy) where `CGI.unescape` is applied to all POST fields. It doesn't check content-type. I'll gate it off for `/sso/acs`.

akshay: Good. Note on KMS: key rotation would produce a different error (IncorrectKey/AccessDenied). InvalidCiphertext strongly points to truncated/malformed ciphertext.

olivia: Action list: 1) revert ingress buffer change (samir) 2) disable telemetry decode hook for /sso endpoints (maria) 3) replay a full assertion from IdP via curl to validate KMS decrypt (akshay) 4) query CloudTrail for Decrypt errors on alias `alias/redwood-sso` between the timestamps (samir) 5) change provisioning fallback so empty `roles` attribute fails the SCIM job instead of defaulting to read-only (maria).

samir: CloudTrail snippet: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --max-results 50 | jq '.Events[] | select(.EventTime >= "2026-04-02T15:10:00Z" and .EventTime <= "2026-04-02T15:40:00Z")|{EventTime,EventName,CloudTrailEvent}'`  - shows several Decrypt attempts with the InvalidCiphertext message.

maria: After disabling the decode hook and rolling back ingress, I re-ran a replay of the full IdP assertion and KMS decrypts cleanly. SCIM provisioning replay now assigns correct roles. :tada:

akshay: Follow-ups: add monitoring around `saml_response_bytes` and an alert on KMS Decrypt error rate > 1/min. Also add a unit test in provisioning pipeline: if roles missing -> mark as `provision_failure` and emit audit event. No silent fallback.

olivia: Postmortem takeaways: - root cause = ingress buffer reduction + blind form-decoding middleware = base64 corruption of EncryptedAssertion -> KMS InvalidCiphertext -> provisioning fallback to read-only. - mitigation = roll back, disable decode hook, hard-fail SCIM when roles absent, add saml size + kms error alerts, request IdP to consider SCIM for large group lists.

maria: I'll open the follow-up PRs: telemetry gating, provisioning guard, and alerts. Will also add a short customer-facing blurb for the affected orgs. Thanks everyone. :heart:

infra-bot: rollback completed: chart/ingress-controller -> v2.3.1 restored at 2026-04-02T15:27:00Z. Monitoring: response sizes back to normal.
